// ─── TEMPLATE · base training config ─: One config directory = one run_jobs() call. This file (template_config.json) holds the BASE config; configs_list.json in the same directory lists the named variants layered on top of it. Keys flagged OPTIONAL below appear only in the runs that use them.
// OPTIONAL · base-level parameter sweep: Usually left null here and set per-variant in configs_list.json. When set, each value is expanded into its own sub-run.
// TRAINING PARAMETERS · learning rates: cx_* = cortex, cb_* = cerebellum, fb_* = feedback pathway. Schedulers accept false, an int step, or "cosine".
// TRAINING PARAMETERS · OPTIONAL extras: Add inside train_params only for the runs that use them — local plasticity (CxLocal): "local_lr": 1e-4, "local_rule_settings": [1, 0, false]. Cortex LR schedule (damage / RNN washout): "cx_scheduler": false.
// TRAINING SETTINGS · OPTIONAL: continual / damage runs also set "record_changes": false.
// TASK-SPECIFIC TOP-LEVEL BLOCKS · OPTI: Some run types add their own top-level blocks: continual → "continual_task_params"; damage → "damage_model_state", "damage_epochs_list", "total_epochs"; washout → "pert_windows", "washout_epochs". See those config directories for the exact shape.
